purpose: Two-argument Args map_each(item, expander) (StarlarkCustomCommandLine.applyMapEach / wantsDirectoryExpander, analysis/starlark/StarlarkCustomCommandLine.java:1085-1188): a StarlarkFunction (def or lambda) declaring two or more parameters gets a DirectoryExpander (`type()` DirectoryExpander) whose expand(file) is a tree artifact input's files (FullExpander, sorted by relative path) or [file]; a directory with `expand_directories = False` reaches such a map_each as it is, with `expand_directories = True` its files do; a directory that is no action input is `Failed to expand directory <generated file ...>. Only directories that are action inputs can be expanded.` when the action executes. Any callable maps a directory's files at execution time: a top-level def, a closure with allow_closure = True (retained with its analysis module, like Bazel's retained StarlarkCallable), a lambda, a built-in (`str`). Motivation: after Args map_each callables, `build --nobuild //src/ts/...` on ~/code stopped at `analysis of //src/ts/bport:layers: ... js_image_layer.bzl:520, in _js_image_layer_impl  entries.add_all(  error: map_each failed: ... map_entry() missing 1 required positional argument: expander` (aspect_rules_js 2.9.2 js_image_layer's map_entry closure over expanded runfiles directories, js/private/js_image_layer.bzl:460-526).

reference.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME/TMPDIR private LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8; one fresh copy of the fixture workspace per case (the genuine platforms 1.0.0 module extracted into `platforms` from tests/fixtures/label_repo_name/platforms_archive.json)

normalization: <WS> = the case's workspace copy; <OB> = the genuine output base; <CACHE> = the native cache; elapsed times <T>. Outputs are the top-level outputs (genuine --show_result lines, bazel-bin = bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin; native LABEL<TAB>PATH lines below the action output root) as [mode, contents].
comparison (tests/directory_expander.rs,: MATCH: success equal; WARNING lines equal in order; a failing case's genuine message (or the recorded part of it) (the `Error in <callable>: ` / `Error: ` Starlark text, else the rule error following an empty `in KIND rule L: ` line, else the first ERROR message) is contained in native stderr; built top-level outputs (path below bazel-out -> [mode, contents]) equal; a `test` case's stdout (the test summary, ` in N.Ns` run times as ` in <T>s`) equal; a successful `run` case's stdout (the program's output) equal; a `query` case's stdout equal; the recorded outputs' existence after the command equal. DECLARED_DIVERGENCE: native fails with the recorded message.
genuine_key_findings: Eager values: expand(file) of a file is [file] (`pkg/a.txt<-a.txt`, `DirectoryExpander:False:pkg/a.txt:1`); `def f(x, *rest)` gets the expander too (rest=1); a 1-parameter def and `str` get the item alone.

expand_directories = True: map_each sees each file of the tree (is_directory False, short_path pkg/probe_d/a, root bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin, owner name probe, expand = [file]) in relative-path byte order (a, c, sub/b); expand_directories = False: map_each(dir, expander) sees the tree (`DirectoryExpander:True:pkg/probe_d:3`) and expand lists its 3 files; js_image_layer's closure `map_entry` (allow_closure) over a source file and a tree with before_each; a 2-parameter lambda; add_joined over expanded files; the same in a spawn's command line; `--nobuild` analyzes it all without expanding.

expand() of a tree that is no input of the action fails the action: `NotInput pkg/not_input.txt failed: ... Error in expand: Failed to expand directory <generated file pkg/not_input_other>. Only directories that are action inputs can be expanded.`; `--nobuild` succeeds.
known_divergences: Native prints its own result format (`LABEL\tPATH`, `bazel-rs: N actions executed ...`), no INFO lines, and the action failure with its own `action '...': Action ... failed: map_each failed:` prefix and traceback form (the message is Bazel's).

Native maps non-directory values eagerly at analysis time (unchanged): a DirectoryExpander there expands non-directories only, so a map_each expanding a tree while mapping a non-directory value fails explicitly natively (genuine expands it when the action executes); the list expand() returns is mutable natively.
Native is passed --experimental-builtin-modules in every case (as in the other paired fixtures).
